about: Pre-recorded Arabic introductions made with Canva AI Voice, one for each persona. They are recordings of a fixed welcome, never live speech, and play only when the person presses Play. Canva downloads AI Voice only inside an MP4 video; add a clip with: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe tools\import_canva_intro.py --persona mulhim|ilham --input <the MP4> --voice "<voice name in Canva>". The tool copies the audio track out without re-encoding, refuses silent or broken files, and fills in 'src', 'transcript' and 'provenance' here. While 'src' is null the introduction is not offered.
